=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/claude_twin_sync.py:checks_green function | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The marker filter uses a substring match that can incorrectly skip check runs from a different run ID that happens to contain the shorter run ID as a substring.
  WHY IT FAILS AT RUNTIME: Under rare collision of GitHub Actions run IDs, a legitimate check run from a different workflow run would be treated as the twin-sync workflow's own run and silently skipped, causing the merge check to pass with fewer verified checks than intended.
- scripts/claude_pr_sweep.py:line ~83 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `claude_pr_sweep.py` defines its own `CLAUDE_TWIN_SYNC_BRANCH_PREFIX` constant rather than importing `SYNC_BRANCH_PREFIX` from `claude_twin_sync.py`.
  WHY IT FAILS AT RUNTIME: A future change to the sync branch prefix in `claude_twin_sync.py` without updating `claude_pr_sweep.py` would mean the sweep starts queuing fixer sessions for sync PRs that should be excluded. CLAUDE.md §28.C says these PRs are merged by the sync workflow or the owner and should never have AI fixers. The test catches this at CI time, so the window is PR-open-to-test-run.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
